mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, user_name as userName, password_hash as passwordHash, status from auth_user order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into auth_user (user_id, user_name, password_hash, status) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{passwordHash}, #{status})

insert into trace_event (trace_id, process_id, business_key, process_type, step_id, service_name, event_type, http_method, path, status, elapsed_ms, error_code, error_message, created_at) values (#{traceId}, #{processId}, #{businessKey}, #{processType}, #{stepId}, #{serviceName}, #{eventType}, #{httpMethod}, #{path}, #{status}, #{elapsedMs}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt})
